name: linear-radar
title: Linear Radar
description: Linear issues that involve you, unseen first

events.label: New Linear issue for me
events.description: An open Linear issue newly shows up in one of your lists: assigned to you, created by you, or mentioning or subscribing you. Once a list passes 50 issues or 100 notifications, an issue older than the first sync never fires, even if it is reassigned to you or mentions you later.

events.label: PR linked to my Linear issue
events.description: A GitHub pull request is linked to an open Linear issue assigned to you (for example a coding agent the issue is delegated to opened it). Fires once per issue, when its first PR is linked; an issue that already had a PR when the workspace was first synced never fires.

events.label: Someone mentioned me on a Linear issue
events.description: Someone @mentions you in a Linear issue's description or in a comment, on any issue, open or closed. Fires once per mention, with the comment text in the brief. Read from your latest 100 Linear notifications: mentions made before the workspace's first sync never fire.
events.key: One per Linear mention notification (its id)

events.label: The agent on my Linear issue commented
events.description: The agent an issue assigned to you is delegated to posts a comment on it: top level or a thread reply, agent-session replies included. Fires once per comment, with the issue, the comment and the comment it replies to in the brief. Comments that match the skip pattern in Linear Radar's settings never fire, nor comments made before the workspace's first sync, before the poll ahead of the one that first saw the issue, or before the skip pattern last changed.
